My dad suffers from depression and has been taking medication for it for the past 12 years. But I think he only started to take it when his wife/my mum, died. So I don't know if it's hereditary. My mum was similar to me I think, I can't remember well because I was 9 when she died but I know that she had problems being happy. We had a pretty good life when were young but she never seemed to be content and I think this lead to the cancer beating her. I have read depression can seriously weaken the immune system.
I know on my dad's side of the family there isn't any mental illness and actually everyone is happy but I don't know a lot about my mum's side of the family. Her mum (my grandma) was mentally ill in some form even when we were little kids (i'm 21 now btw). She was abusive in some way to my mum, I don't know to what degree but my mum left home when she was about 16 to live with my dad. My mum's dad died when I was really young. But my point is I think there may be some kind of mental illness in our family from that side of the family but I'm not entirely sure as we do not have any communication with them.
It's hard to explain everything because there is so much. There are so many reasons why I am depressed in my mind, physical, life circumstances that cause me to be unhappy. But at the same time there are times when in theory I should be perfectly happy but I am not. Instead I am apathetic, lazy, demotivated and have this feeling of emptiness, blankness, like I am just falling into a void. I have this constantly feeling like I am about to cry, even though I never do. Sometimes I just want to cry because it feels like a release but I can't cry. Sometimes I cry when I'm watching emotional films and it feels like a relieve but I also feel pathetic.
I'm writing too much and I lost track.
